policy: Add reviewed offline runtimes where feasible; report remaining unsupported cases explicitly.
preserved_constraints: No live accounts or external service actions in skill executions.
Do not substitute easier tasks for unsupported original workflows.
Do not count unsupported or unmeasured cases as observed execution failures.
Review public inputs, task requests, runtime adapters and independent verifiers before freezing each new task.
Keep prior freezes, implementations, measurements and setup costs intact.
Use the same frozen inputs and adapter for both exact models and all five independent repeats.
Use pinned runtime images, no network, no host mounts or credentials, non-root execution and resource limits.
Stratify new runtime results rather than treating adapter changes as controlled timing comparisons.
